claim.quote: This observation provides strong direct detection constraints on WIMP-proton spin-dependent scattering for WIMP masses > 20 GeV/c$^{2}$.

key_value_text.locator: arXiv:1008.3518, main text (PDF page 4) and Figure 4 caption
key_value_text.note: The paper states its limit as a plotted curve of the spin-dependent WIMP-proton cross section against WIMP mass (Fig. 4) and gives no single cross-section number, so `key_value` stays empty. The number 6.7 is a Poisson upper limit on the mean signal count, not a cross section. The 'effective exposure of 28.1 kg-day' of the abstract, which the record used as its key value until 2026-10-29, is in `summary.technical`.
key_value_text.quote: Interpreting the three events in the signal region as WIMP candidates results in a 90% Poisson upper limit of 6.7 for the mean of the signal. The resulting improved limits on spin-dependent WIMP-proton couplings are shown in Fig. 4.
key_value_text.value: Spin-dependent WIMP-proton limits are the curve of Fig. 4, set from a 90% Poisson upper limit of 6.7 for the mean of the signal (three candidate events).

name: Improved Limits on Spin-Dependent WIMP-Proton Interactions from a Two Liter CF$_3$I Bubble Chamber
notes: The arXiv listing's abstract still reads 'the strongest direct detection constraint to date'; the paper itself (v2, 7 Mar 2011) says 'strong direct detection constraints', and the record follows the paper (2026-10-29).

summary.plain: A 3.5-kg bubble chamber of superheated CF3I in the MINOS tunnel at Fermilab saw three candidate events, consistent with neutrons, and set improved limits on spin-dependent WIMP-proton scattering for heavier WIMPs.
summary.technical: 3.5 kg CF3I, 19 August-18 December 2009, MINOS near-detector tunnel (300 ft overburden); acoustic alpha/nuclear-recoil discrimination; three dark matter candidate events in an effective exposure of 28.1 kg-day, consistent with a neutron background; limit for WIMP masses above 20 GeV/c^2 (Phys. Rev. Lett. 106, 021303).

title: Improved Limits on Spin-Dependent WIMP-Proton Interactions from a Two Liter CF$_3$I Bubble Chamber
why_it_matters: The paper reports strong direct-detection constraints on WIMP-proton spin-dependent scattering for WIMP masses above 20 GeV/c^2, improving on earlier limits (its title: "Improved Limits on Spin-Dependent WIMP-Proton Interactions").
